label: context.reference
text:
Use the bound world_mcp_unity Application and its current tool and resource catalogs. Resolve the intended Editor and project, then inspect the scene, asset or code involved in the task. Available operations and their argument schemas come from the connected server.

When Unity MCP was connected in Octopus, each server tool is also published as its own unity.<tool> operation; otherwise, and for tools missing from that list, call unity.call_tool with the tool name and arguments. Read resources through unity.read_resource; unity.get_prompt exposes declared prompts. Refresh the tool catalogue or connection status when the observation requires it. Follow returned job identifiers, pagination and compilation state rather than guessing completion.

Server tools not declared read-only wait for the operator's approval in Octopus before they reach the server. Their mcp.tool.result arrives after the operator decides; a declined call returns error operator_declined and changed nothing. Do not repeat a call while it waits.

Use the Editor's result for the affected asset, scene, compilation or build to assess the change. Report the outcome and any missing dependency.
